cards.title: Lažni linkovi ciljaju gejmere i djecu
cards.body: Kruže lažni „pokloni/free“ linkovi (Roblox, Discord...) koji kradu nalog. Reci djetetu da ne klikće. (viđeno danas: 12)
cards.title_en: Fake links target gamers and kids
cards.body_en: Fake „free/gift“ links (Roblox, Discord...) steal accounts. Tell your child not to click. (seen today: 12)

cards.title: Novi phishing za banke i plaćanje
cards.body: Lažne „login/secure“ stranice kradu podatke kartice i naloga. Ne unosi ništa preko linka iz poruke. (viđeno danas: 5)
cards.title_en: New phishing for banks and payments
cards.body_en: Fake „login/secure“ pages steal card and account details. Don't enter anything via a link in a message. (seen today: 5)

cards.title: Lažna obavještenja o paketu i carini
cards.body: Poruke „platite carinu/dostavu“ vode na lažne stranice. Prava pošta ne traži plaćanje preko linka. (viđeno danas: 3)
cards.body_en: „Pay customs/delivery“ messages lead to fake sites. Real post never asks to pay via a link. (seen today: 3)

cards.title: Lažni kripto alati i novčanici
cards.body: Kruže lažni „recovery/wallet“ alati koji kradu novčanik. Nema legalnog alata za „povrat“ kripta. (viđeno danas: 6)
cards.body_en: Fake „recovery/wallet“ tools steal your wallet. There is no legit tool to „recover“ crypto. (seen today: 6)
